sources.query: SELECT CCID, PERIOD_NUM, SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, AMOUNT FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS
SELECT s.CCID, s.PERIOD_NUM, s.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, CAST(ROUND(s.AMOUNT, 2) AS NUMBER(28,2)) AS AMOUNT FROM FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES s
